heading_choice: Target +X is source +Y projected onto plane perpendicular to estimated up; +Y = up cross +X. Not compass north or confirmed robot forward.
origin_choice: Same physical origin as camera_init; floor height not established.
assumptions: First ~2s IMU approximately static. Initial FAST-LIO state rotation is identity and IMU_init does not rotate world axes; use initial IMU direction as approximate initial camera_init up. Not calibrated floor or exact final estimator gravity.
recipe: z = normalize(mean_initial_acc); x = normalize(old_Y - z*dot(z,old_Y)); y = cross(z,x); R rows = [x,y,z]. Column convention: p_target = R @ p_source; no translation.
